task.description: WF-07 step 3: independently check the business plan against REQ-005 AC3–AC6: every number, every citation, arithmetic, required sections, 30-day plan and kill criteria, [образец] separation, WF-06 relation, anything misleading.
acceptance_criteria: PASS or FAIL with located findings

result.summary:
FAIL (round 1). 7 MAJOR + 6 MINOR findings. Evidence of own checks below.

PASSED (own runs): (a) grep '^## ' -> 15 headings, exact and in order (python compare = True). (b) Script + manual row-by-row check: every number cited to research/<file>.md is present in that file OUTSIDE <!-- conclusion --> markers with a link; project-doc numbers found in STATE.md (111 tests, REQ-001 pending, start decision not taken) and verdict-2.md (21:20, 11/30, 15, 4/5, 3/5, 2 of 3). The author's 8 flagged blocks are shown arithmetic or Д-marked values - confirmed. (c) One '### Допущения' table (Д1-Д17) holds all model assumptions. Recomputed: Р1 359 177; Р2 344 177; Р3 81,30->82, 362 251,40, 4 100; Р4 8,13->9, 397 593; Р5 4 130 124, 4,13->5; Р6 3 445,81, 7 554,19, 45,56->46, 347 492,74, 110 000,73+18 860=128 860,73; Р7 59 177; 30/7*10=42,86, 3+20+12+3+3=41, slack 1,86; 3*44 177=132 531; 200*4 325=865 000; 9/0,2=45; 41/5/23; $5 000=2,21 млн; $150-250=66-110 тыс. - all correct. (d) 5-step 30-day plan, each with a checkable result; numeric kill criteria exist for all 3 lines. (e) [образец] never presented as the owner's product; mentor consent in Риски (L499) and Решения владельца (L637). (f) WF-06 relation 21:20, low confidence, fallback Sai, KPP 11/30 with 1/1/1 - matches verdict-2.

MAJOR:
1. README.md:516-519 - payment = 'полученные деньги или подписанный заказ' called 'то же правило, что в WF-06'; verdict-2.md:257 says 'только полученные деньги'. Source does not say what the plan claims; the pipeline kill criterion (L537) gets a looser bar than quizzes' '2 из 3 фактически заплатили'. Fix: money received only, or state it is looser than WF-06 and why.
2. Mentor consent vs 30-day plan. L52 says consent first, then conversations. But L524-525: step 1 (days 1-7) may close as 'ментор не ответил', step 2 (days 3-21) collects 'заплатил / подписал заказ', and L540 closes the form only on a written 'нет'. That contradicts Риски L499 ('без его согласия продавать ... нельзя'): the owner could take money for a [образец]-method kit without consent. Fix: ask for price or prepayment only after written consent is recorded in decisions/; treat no answer as no consent; until then, pain interviews only.
3. Unproven payment presented as proven. L41 'Платят за внедрение и обучение', L339 'Есть доказательства оплаты в мире', L309 and L578 'оплата найдена ... услуги конвейера'. research/agent-pipeline.md section 5 (L151-176) has only vendor price lists. 'за что платят' appears only inside the conclusion region (L333-339), and WF-06's own standard (verdict-2.md:56-57) says offers are not proven purchases. The kriv.ai page I opened shows one unnamed testimonial only. The ranking reason (L55) also rests on service forms the owner refused, while the form actually tested (self-installed kit) has zero payment evidence (L334-335), the same as Pixel Office. L334 calls the kit 'совпадает с вашими целями', but its buyer is a company (the plan's own row L314 marks selling to organizations as excluded). Fix: say 'опубликованные цены, покупки не подтверждены' and restate the ranking reason honestly.
4. METR cherry-pick, L93-96. It cites the 2025 finding (19% longer) and quotes 'only very weak evidence' as if it qualified that finding. research/agent-pipeline.md:99-104 and metr.org/2026 (opened) show the 2026 update estimates -18% and -4% time, i.e. developers were faster. The 'very weak evidence' phrase is about the size of that increase. Fix: report both results or drop METR as evidence of pain.
5. The owner's evaluation rule is hidden where it cuts against the advice. owner-goals.md says 'мне важно чтобы ты подтвердил или доказал свои варианты'; grep finds it nowhere in README, and the goals table (L307-314) omits it. L576 says quizzes are 'не слабее' when by the plan's own evidence they are stronger (category purchases 4/5 vs no payment evidence for any tested form). The advice (L586-591) ranks 'with agents' above proof and drops 'востребовано' from the REQ-005 quote. Fix: quote the rule and say plainly that by it WF-06 quizzes lead; present 'this plan first' as trading proof for fit.
6. Prior rejections not disclosed. ideas/05-drugie-idei.md records these outcomes: open agent kit + paid layer 'Отброшено: это продажа себя'; training/workshops rejected; audit of others' code rejected; reviewer agent 'Отброшено: гиганты'; pipeline role inside [компания] 'Не выбрано: цель - своё дело'; [образец] 'не наш продукт'. The recommended-first Line 2 re-proposes close variants without saying so. ideas/ is not in the writer's source list (an ORCH gap), but verdict-2.md:161 already points to this list. Fix: add ideas/05 as a source and state each prior outcome and what differs now.
7. Pixel Office kill criterion is incomplete (L532-536). If there are still fewer than 300 visitors after the single 14-day extension, 'то же правило' gives neither stop nor go, so low traffic never triggers the stop. Fix: define that outcome, e.g. fewer than 300 visitors after the extension = stop the paid version.

MINOR:
8. L584 and L634 state 'обе проверки не потянуть' as fact, but it rests only on Д14/Д15 (the 1,86 h slack comes from the chosen numbers). L510 'не больше одной проверки одновременно' contradicts running three line checks in parallel (L524-527).
9. L487-489 'в принципе число достижимое' contradicts L538-540 (45 companies needed, 37 vacancies, which per research L184-185 include irrelevant ones).
10. L337 and L448 use OSN.KZ prices as the pilot anchor without the research caveat 'не для команд разработки' (agent-pipeline.md:173; confirmed on osn.kz).
11. L62 says the 41 hours are calculated in «Финансовая модель»; they are calculated in «Ресурсы и затраты».
12. L397: the gate 'Линия не сработала по критерию остановки' reads as its opposite. Say 'критерий остановки не сработал'.
13. L375-376 and L612-623 speak of 'only your own texts', but Sai's role files point to [образец] canonical mandates (e.g. .claude/agents/plan-validator.md:6-7) and WF-07 uses the [образец] handoff format. A kit made only from the owner's texts needs rewriting, not extraction; say so. Also: pipeline kill (L537) is undefined if fewer than 10 conversations take place.

Spot-checks (18 URLs across all 3 files): all confirmed, except METR 2026 (finding 4) and the Nacbank rate for 29.09. That page now shows only 30.09 (439,37 / 5,22), so 441,77 cannot be re-verified; the difference is 0,5% and immaterial. The Pixel Agents count is now 86 831, consistent with 86 755 growing.
